meta.title: RLS Policy Coverage Gap Audit — Sprint 0 §14

covered.evidence: V3:17-18 (ENABLE+FORCE RLS), V3:28-32 (policy USING department_id = app.current_tenant_id)
V3:19-20 (ENABLE+FORCE RLS), V3:34-42 (policy via EXISTS employee/department_id = app.current_tenant_id)
V14:53-54 (ENABLE+FORCE RLS), V14:61-65 (policy USING id = app.current_tenant_id::uuid)
V14:55-56 (ENABLE+FORCE RLS), V14:67-71 (policy USING tenant_id = app.current_tenant_id::uuid)
V14:57-58 (ENABLE+FORCE RLS), V14:73-77 (policy USING tenant_id = app.current_tenant_id::uuid)

rls_enabled_no_policy.policy_evidence: NONE — no CREATE POLICY anywhere in V0-V14
rls_enabled_no_policy.impact: ROLE table INVISIBLE to kintai_app. Role lookup in login/auth pipeline FAILS. Likely this table should NOT have RLS at all (it is global RBAC, not tenant-scoped). Either DROP RLS or add a blanket policy FOR all authenticated users.
role_permission table INVISIBLE. Permission checks during auth FAIL. Same as role — likely should not have RLS.
Attendance records INVISIBLE. Employees cannot clock in/out, managers cannot review. Critical P0 bug.
Break records INVISIBLE. Cannot log or view breaks.
Leave type catalog INVISIBLE. Dropdowns empty, leave request creation fails. Should either DROP RLS (global data) or add blanket policy.
Leave balances INVISIBLE. Employees cannot check remaining PTO.
Leave requests INVISIBLE. Cannot submit or approve leave.
Payroll runs INVISIBLE. Payroll processing pipeline broken.
Payroll line items INVISIBLE. Payslips cannot be generated.
Audit log INVISIBLE. Audit reader role BYPASSRLS avoids this for readers, but kintai_app role cannot SELECT audit_log.
Audit log detail INVISIBLE. Same as audit_log.

tenant_scoped_no_rls.scope_mechanism: Used as tenant proxy (employee.department_id = app.current_tenant_id in V3 policy). Departments ARE tenant-scoped.
tenant_scoped_no_rls.evidence: V2:7-19 (CREATE TABLE, no tenant_id, no RLS, no policy)

tenant_scoped_no_rls.scope_mechanism: Referenced by employee (tenant-scoped via employee FK chain). Positions are tenant-specific.
tenant_scoped_no_rls.evidence: V2:24-37 (CREATE TABLE, no tenant_id, no RLS)
V2:73-93 (CREATE TABLE, no tenant_id, no RLS)

tenant_scoped_no_rls.scope_mechanism: FK timesheet_id → timesheet → employee → department = tenant

non_tenant_tables.reason: Global RBAC catalog. No tenant_id, no FK to employee. Correctly has NO RLS.
National tax bracket reference data (Japan). Global by nature.
National social insurance rate reference (Japan). Global by nature.
Japan national holiday calendar. Global reference data.
Key-value app configuration. Could be global or per-tenant; no tenant_id column. If per-tenant, needs migration to add tenant_id + RLS.
No employee_id or tenant_id. Could be cross-tenant lookup. If per-tenant, needs migration.

debatable_or_complex.note: Polymorphic (entity_type/entity_id). Uploaded_by FK to employee suggests tenant-scope, but entity could span tenants. Needs design decision before RLS.
Polymorphic (entity_type/entity_id). Cannot write tenant-isolation policy without knowing entity tenant mapping strategy.
Seed/lookup data (3 shifts: normal/early/night). Currently global. If per-tenant, needs design change.

summary.blocked_tables: 16 tables with RLS FORCE + no policy are COMPLETELY INVISIBLE to kintai_app role. This is a P0 bug — all features relying on these tables fail silently.

recommendation.fix_category_A_rls_enabled_no_policy: 11 tenant-scoped tables need a tenant-isolation CREATE POLICY in V15 (attendance_record, break_record, leave_balance, leave_request, payroll_run, payroll_item, allowance, deduction, bonus_payment, year_end_adjustment, resident_tax)
recommendation.fix_category_B_rls_wrongly_enabled: 3 global reference tables need DROP RLS in V15 (role, role_permission, leave_type) — they have FORCE RLS but no policy, making them invisible. They are reference data, not tenant-scoped.
recommendation.fix_category_C_rls_on_audit_tables: 2 audit tables either need a tenant-isolation policy or audit_writer BYPASSRLS handles them differently. Currently invisible to kintai_app. (audit_log, audit_log_detail)
recommendation.fix_category_D_tenant_scoped_no_rls_at_a: 12 tables need ENABLE RLS + tenant-isolation policy in V15 (department, position, contract, bank_account, dependent_family, commute_route, emergency_contact, shift_assignment, notification, refresh_token, timesheet, timesheet_entry)
recommendation.total_v15_scope: 3 DROP RLS + 25 new policies across 25 tenant-scoped tables (some may share a single policy via table inheritance patterns, but each table needs at minimum one policy)
